Documented violence: 2008 killing, 2020 assault, pride attacks — dated/scattered (tier 4). State hostility: education law (propaganda ban), municipal ban. Hate crime enforcement failure documented 2015. Regional court mandate for LGR pending — recency: 2025 opinion favorable.

So the worst feature: documented societal hostility with thin recourse (tier 3), plus state propaganda-law hostility (but that's mostly aimed at education/representation, not directly visitor-facing), dated incidents (tier 4), hate-crime enforcement failure (dated 2015). No criminalization of gender expression, no facility bans documented. Score: mid-range. Maybe 0.55-0.65. Social climate hostile: 27% openness, far-right hostility. But for a trans visitor outed — no criminal exposure, functioning courts (partially working FOR trans — regional court rulings), scattered violence incidents. I'd say 0.62.

Police bribery/extortion using ambiguous statute = police lever (tier 2-ish, but targeted at perceived-gay men, bribery not imprisonment). For trans visitor outed: police extortion risk, hostile social climate, no recourse. Family violence is resident-focused. Score: elevated — maybe 0.42-0.50. The police invoking the ambiguous law to extort is a documented ongoing practice (2022-2023), which is a real traveler-facing risk if outed (police interaction). But no trans-specific criminalization, no trans-specific documented targeting. Social hostility high (73% dislike). Rule of law partially works (abuses investigated when reported). I'd say 0.48.

Let me compare: Dossier 1 vs 5. Dossier 1 has police arrest/torture of gay residents documented (undated), ban on LGBTQ activity, contested criminalization of sodomy in one region (up to 10 years), no acceptance (130th), flight of 90 LGBT people. That's worse than dossier 5. So dossier 1 lower than 5: maybe 0.32 vs 0.48.

Dossier 1: contested criminalization + police torture (undated) + hostile society + no protections. Extrapolation: conflict, Islamist enforcement of Islamic law. I'd say 0.33.

Dossier 2 highest: 0.87. Dossier 4 mid: 0.62. Dossier 3 lowest: 0.12.

Dossier 4 has documented exposures: education propaganda law targeting gender identity (state threat-framing at the representation level, not visitor-facing directly), hate-crime investigation failure, hostile social survey (LGBT-wide — discount), scattered violence, no LGR (resident). No universal-exposure measure documented (no bathroom bans — explicitly "no statute governs which public facilities"). Border: passport examined ordinarily, no separate question — positive. So exposures are mostly social hostility (tier 3) with dated incidents (tier 4) and paper protections not shown operating (tier 5) plus one state hostility layer (propaganda law). Worst feature tier 3 → above dossier 1, well above 3. 0.62 seems reasonable, maybe 0.60.
